battle.name: 北京之戰
battle.brief: 大定十八年仿汴京建成的金中都，自貞祐元年十月宣宗南遷後被蒙古軍圍住，木華黎主圍，成吉思汗自西夏回軍督攻，至貞祐三年二月城破，宮闕盡焚，金勢退保河南。此役把弩的兩面一次顯齊：守方倚弩於城堞仍守不住地道與飛石，攻方則靠降附漢人的攻城技藝補上蒙古騎兵的不足。

kit.name: 十字弩
kit.history: 弩把射速交給了機械，代價是裝填慢。城牆上它比長弓可靠，野戰裡它比長弓脆弱。

countries: 交戰雙方是蒙古大汗國與金朝。蒙古一方，1211 年秋野狐嶺破金主力之後，兵分三路南下：木華黎經略河北與山西南部，哲別、速不台西征，成吉思汗居中統御；至 1213 年冬，中都已被圍成孤城。其軍隊編制仍以蒙古本部的千戶、百戶為骨幹，同時大量吸收漢地與契丹的降附將士，專任攻城、鑿地道、造器械之役。圍城之師由木華黎主之，1215 年成吉思汗自西夏河西回軍後親至督攻。金一方，宣宗於貞祐元年十月遷都汴京，中都只留中都留守府完顏承暉與禁軍、兵馬都監所部殘兵；城外州縣多已叛金附蒙，河北、山東兩路州郡全失，守軍須靠南京汴京的節度使司與河東、山東行台遣兵接應，能上城的兵並不多。城內外另有民間武裝紅襖軍，自 1213 年起在河東、山西、河北、山東響應蒙古，攻城期內於城郊游擊、斷糧，是蒙古得以孤立中都的助力。金廷在圍城期間仍兩度遣使議和，朝中議和派與死戰派相持，守城方因此屢失主見，決策往往慢過城牆崩壞的速度。
countriesEn: The two sides were the Mongol Great Khanate and the Jin dynasty. On the Mongol side, after breaking the main Jin army at Yehuling in the autumn of 1211, the forces were split into three columns moving south: Muqali to work Hebei and southern Shanxi, Jebai and Subutai on the western expedition, with Genghis Khan himself in the centre giving the general direction. By the winter of 1213 Zhongdu had been reduced to an isolated city. The Mongol order of battle still rested on the thousand-house and hundred-house units of the Mongol proper, and at the same time it absorbed in great numbers Han Chinese and Khitan officers and men who had surrendered, assigning them specifically to the work of assault, of tunnelling and of building siege equipment. The besieging force was commanded by Muqali; after Genghis Khan came back from the western campaign against Western Xia in 1215 he arrived in person to direct the assault. On the Jin side, the Xuanzong emperor moved the capital to Bianjing in the tenth month of Zhengyou 1 (1213), leaving at Zhongdu only the Zhongdu garrison under the resident commissioner Wanyan Chenghui, together with the imperial guards and the remnants of the troops of the military commissioners, for the prefectures outside the walls had mostly revolted and gone over to the Mongols, and the circuits of Hebei and Shandong had been lost entirely. The defenders could be reinforced only from the Southern Capital at Bianjing and from the field headquarters in Hedong and Shandong, and the number of men who could actually be posted on the walls was small. Inside and outside the city there were also the armed bands of the Red Jackets, who from 1213 rose in Hedong, Shanxi, Hebei and Shandong in answer to the Mongols, harried the suburbs during the siege and cut the supply road, and were a real help to the Mongols in isolating Zhongdu. The Jin court twice sent envoys to treat for peace during the siege, and at court the party of negotiation and the party of fighting to the death quarrelled with each other, so the defence repeatedly lost its nerve and its decisions were slower than the collapse of its walls.
people: 成吉思汗是這一役的總指揮。1211 年秋他在野狐嶺大破金軍主力，1212、1213 年連下河北、山東諸州，1213 年冬三路進軍直抵中都城下；圍城之後因西夏河西用兵而西行，1215 年秋自河套回師，抵中都時圍城已逾一年，最後的攻城遂在他的督率下完成。他並不把中都視為可久守之地：城破之後不久即下令焚毀宮闕，蒙古軍大掠而還。木華黎是實際主持圍城的人，1214 年受命經略太行以東，率軍留在中都城下與金人相持，同時掃平河北、山西的殘餘據點，1223 年病卒於河東，其部眾由其子查剌承領。金宣宗完顏允恭自 1213 年十月南遷汴京，圍城期間在南京遙控，留守中都的完顏承暉在城破時殉城，一說自盡於闕下，一說死於亂軍。金朝右丞相僕散安貞是 1211 年主和之人，以金帛、牛馬與人口換得蒙古一年的喘息，卻因此把邊防備鬆，戰事再起之後被貶黜。蒙古一方的攻城主力有相當部分是降附的漢人與契丹將士，攻城器械亦多出自他們之手。金廷內部則有宗室與權臣互疑、議和與死戰之爭，完顏綱在 1214 年被誅，說明朝中對戰與降的分歧已到互相傾軋的地步；主和者屢遭貶斥，主戰者又無力挽回，於是中都城頭的指揮始終缺一個能定大局的人。
peopleEn: Genghis Khan was the overall commander of this campaign. In the autumn of 1211 he broke the main Jin army at Yehuling, in 1212 and 1213 he took the prefectures of Hebei and Shandong one after another, and in the winter of 1213 his three columns drove down to the walls of Zhongdu. After the city was invested he went west to deal with Western Xia, and in the autumn of 1215 he came back from around the Ordos; by the time he reached Zhongdu the siege had already run more than a year, and the final assault was carried out under his personal direction. He did not regard Zhongdu as a city worth holding: shortly after it fell he ordered the palace burned, and the Mongol army plundered and withdrew. Muqali was the man who actually conducted the siege. In 1214 he was charged with the task of the lands east of the Taihang, stayed before Zhongdu holding the Jin in place while he swept up the remaining strongholds in Hebei and Shanxi, and died of illness in Hedong in 1223, his command passing to his son Qala. The Jin emperor Xuanzong, Wanyan Yungong, had moved south to Bianjing in the tenth month of 1213 and ruled the war from the Southern Capital during the siege; the resident commissioner of Zhongdu, Wanyan Chenghui, died with the city, one account saying that he killed himself below the gate towers and another that he was killed in the fighting. The Jin chancellor Pusan Anzhen was the man who made the peace of 1211, buying the Mongols a year's respite with gold, silk, cattle, horses and people, and in doing so left the frontier defence slack; when the war broke out again he was demoted and driven out. A considerable part of the Mongol assault force consisted of surrendered Han Chinese and Khitan soldiers, and much of the siege equipment came from their hands. Inside the Jin court there was mutual suspicion between the imperial clan and the ministers, and a quarrel between the party of negotiation and the party of fighting to the death; Wanyan Gang was executed in 1214, which shows that the division over war and surrender had reached the point of mutual destruction, and since the advocates of peace were repeatedly demoted while the advocates of war could not repair the situation, the command on the walls of Zhongdu never had a single man able to settle the whole design.
kits: 卡上這件十字弩，在中都攻防裡的位置是守方的城頭火力。弩以機械張力取代拉弓的人力，單發力道與穿透力勝過長弓，金人把神臂弓、硬弓與手用十字弩分置城堞，箭鏃淬毒者更能透甲見血；蒙古人自己也用弩，但多排在攻城序列的後段，用以封住通道、壓制城頭。弩的代價在史書裏講得很直白：裝填慢。守城時它可以安在堞後，瞄定一線，一發一停；野戰裏它必須跟著騎兵移動，一發還沒上弦，蒙古的馬已經衝到跟前。所以中都之戰裏，弩只在城頭找到了自己的位置，而守方卻把整座城防的骨架押在弩弓之上，卻沒有一件真正能摧毀城垣的器械。攻方這邊，蒙古依靠撞車、雲梯、穴地與拋石那類器械，這批匠人與器械多來自河西與漠北的降附漢人、西夏工匠。金軍在城頭備有飛石、撞竿、拒馬與陷坑，並已在河中、太原一線用過飛火、震天雷一類火藥器械。器械一對比，弩的射程遠短於拋石，而拋石一旦運到城下，中都的城樓與城堞上的射手才真正暴露在掩體之外。
kitsEn: The crossbow on this card occupied the position of the defenders' fire from the walls. The weapon transfers the draw of the bow to a machine, and a single bolt out of it strikes with more force and penetration than a long bow can give; the Jin set the Shenfu bow, the hard bow and hand crossbows along the parapets, and bolts whose heads were poisoned were said to pierce armour and draw blood. The Mongols used crossbows too, but placed them late in the order of assault, to seal the approaches and keep down the heads of the defenders. The cost of the weapon is stated plainly in the histories: slow to load. On a wall it can be set behind the parapet, aimed down one line, fired and reloaded; in the field it must travel with the cavalry, and before one bolt is even strung the Mongol horses are already at the gate. So in the battle of Zhongdu the crossbow found its place only on the walls, while the defenders based the whole frame of the city's defence on bows and crossbows and possessed nothing that could truly break a rampart. On the attacking side the Mongols relied on battering rams, scaling ladders, mines and counterweight stone-throwers, and the craftsmen and the machines came largely from surrendered Han Chinese and from the workshops of Western Xia in the river west and in the desert. The Jin had on the walls stone-throwers by hand, iron rams, cheval-de-frise and pits, and they had already used fire-weapons of the flying fire and the thundering thunder kind in the fighting around Hedong and Taiyuan. Set the two sides of the armoury against each other and the point is plain: the range of the crossbow is far shorter than that of the trebuchet, and once the trebuchet was brought up beneath the walls, the archers on the towers of Zhongdu were genuinely exposed beyond cover.
tactics: 蒙古的圍城是一套以時間換防禦的辦法：先以游騎掃清城外三十里內的據點與烽堠，切斷所有通向中都的陸路，再把攻城主力壓到牆下作穴地與填壕；糧草靠河套、山西的徵集與季節性的草場轉運供給，冬季草料不足時就向西退營，寧可停攻也不散兵。1214 年拖雷假道山西南下，渡黃河後大掠陳州、杞州，直抵汴京外四十餘里而無舟可渡，隨即引兵而還，這一役等於替中都切斷了南面的漕運。城內守方也不是一味死守：金軍多次趁夜出城反擊蒙古營壘，蒙古以營壍、拒馬與遊騎應之；蒙古穴地攻城時，守軍在城內掘地道以當，兩道地坑在牆下相向掘進，是整場圍城中最吃工程能力的一個環節。攻守兩端都遣使往來，金廷屢次求和而蒙古不許；時間愈拖，守軍糧秣愈匱，援兵又始終不來。到最後一攻，蒙古仍以穴地與雲梯同時並用，奪取城頭之後再向下清剿，城門一破，整條防線就整條塌掉。
tacticsEn: The Mongol siege was a method of trading time for defence: first the outlying horsemen swept the posts and beacon stations within thirty li outside the city and cut every road that led to Zhongdu, and then the assault troops were pressed against the walls to mine and to fill the ditches; supplies came by levy from the Ordos and from Shanxi and were shifted according to the season's grazing, and when the winter fodder ran short the army moved its camp west, preferring to suspend the attack rather than disperse the men. In 1214 Tolui marched south by way of Shanxi, forded the Yellow River and laid waste to Chenzhou and Qizhou, coming to within forty li of Bianjing before he could find boats to cross, and then withdrew; that march was in effect the cutting of the southern grain route of Zhongdu. The defenders inside were not simply passive either: the Jin troops went out of the city by night more than once to strike the Mongol camp, and the Mongols answered with their stockades, cheval-de-frise and wandering horse; and when the Mongols drove a mine under the wall, the garrison sank a counter-mine inside the city, two galleries being driven towards each other under the rampart, which was the one stage of the whole siege that demanded the most engineering skill. Envoys passed in both directions throughout, the Jin court asked for terms again and again and the Mongols refused them; the longer it went on the shorter the defenders' grain grew, and the relieving army never came. On the last assault the Mongols still used mines and scaling ladders together, and once the wall was taken they worked downwards; when the gate was broken the whole line of defence came down together.
data: 可核對的數字大致如下。年份：1213 年十月（金貞祐元年）宣宗南遷，蒙古軍合圍中都，至 1215 年二月（貞祐三年）城破，圍城歷時約一年三個月；其後 1215 年秋成吉思汗自河西回師，1223 年木華黎病卒，1234 年金亡於蔡州，距中都陷落十九年。城池：金中都仿北宋汴京營建，外城城周約二十五里，內城即子城城周約九里，城門十有一，皇城（大內）居城中央；盛時城中人口逾百萬的記載出自後期追述，未必精確，但可以看出這是一座都城級的巨城。蒙古兵力：圍城與掃蕩的兵馬，傳統記載常作數十萬，較可信的量級是攻城主力以數萬計，其餘為四出游弋的散騎；1211 年野狐嶺一役金軍集中兵員數十萬的說法，同樣被後人視為誇大。損失：城破之日死者以數十萬計的說法見於後世編纂，難以核實；可以確定的是城中居民大批被擄，宮闕宮室盡焚，器械存量為蒙古軍所取。路距：1214 年拖雷渡黃河，掠陳州、杞州，距汴京四十餘里而不得渡；1214 至 1215 年成吉思汗往來河西，行程數千里。城堞與射手：弩手弓手依城堞分段配置，一發之重可洞穿重甲，然其密度受城堞總長所限，每築一段能容的射手數是固定的。死傷之說：後世編纂多稱城破之日屠殺數十萬，另一說則把大屠殺歸因於圍城既久、城中斷糧之後的失控與攻城軍的劫掠，兩說並存，未有定論。
dataEn: The figures that can be checked run roughly as follows. In time: in the tenth month of Zhengyou 1 (1213) the Xuanzong emperor moved south and the Mongol army closed around Zhongdu, and the city fell in the second month of Zhengyou 3 (1215), so the siege lasted about a year and three months; Genghis Khan returned from the west in the autumn of 1215, Muqali died of illness in 1223, and Jin ended at Caizhou in 1234, nineteen years after the fall of Zhongdu. The city: Jin Zhongdu was laid out on the model of the Northern Song capital of Bianjing, the outer wall measuring about twenty-five li in circuit, the inner city, the zicheng, about nine li, with eleven gates, and the palace enclosure standing in the centre; the account that the city held more than a million people in its prime comes from later recollection and is not exact, but it shows the scale of a capital-sized city. Mongol strength: the besieging and raiding force is conventionally put at several hundred thousand, but the more credible figure is that the assault troops numbered in the tens of thousands with the rest wandering as scattered horse; the claim that the Jin mustered several hundred thousand at Yehuling in 1211 is likewise treated by later scholars as an exaggeration. Losses: the statement that tens of thousands died on the day the city fell appears in later compilations and cannot be verified; what can be certain is that large numbers of the inhabitants were carried off, the palace buildings burned, and the stock of equipment taken by the Mongols. Distances: in 1214 Tolui forded the Yellow River and ravaged Chenzhou and Qizhou, standing forty li from Bianjing without a way to cross; between 1214 and 1215 Genghis Khan travelled back and forth across the river west, a journey of thousands of li. Walls and archers: the crossbow and bow men were posted in sections along the parapets and one bolt could pierce heavy armour, yet their density was bounded by the total length of the wall, so the number of archers that any one section of new wall could hold was fixed. As for the slaughter: later compilations mostly put the dead on the day the city fell at tens of thousands, while another account attributes the great killing to the collapse of control after a long siege and famine, and to the plunder of the assault troops; the two accounts stand side by side without a settled verdict.
cause: 中都會落到這步田地，是三層原因疊出來的。最外一層是金朝自身的敗壞：海陵王貞元元年把都城由舊燕京移到中都，模仿汴京修起三重城垣，耗去國帑無數；其後伐宋失利、北面邊備空虛，傳統說法雖有誇張，卻指出邊軍與轉運之間的漏洞一直沒有填上。金章宗、衛紹王時期朝政日壞，府庫空虛，官府括財括民，人心盡失，中原豪族與契丹、漢人對女真統治的怨望積累，1213 年紅襖軍在河東首先舉起旗幟，就是這股怨望的第一次爆發。中間一層是蒙古：1206 年統一草原之後，成吉思汗並不急著南下，而是先整合西夏、乃蠻、吐蕃諸部，並收攏漢地的匠人與攻城技術，1211 年才以野狐嶺一戰打斷金的河北防線。最內一層是金廷自己的選擇：1211 至 1212 年僕散安貞以割地、納人口、納財貨換來的和約，等於承認河北不可守，邊防從此鬆懈；1213 年蒙古三路南下直抵中都，金廷在守與棄之間掙扎，宣宗最終選擇南遷，把一座空城和滿城居民留給蒙古騎兵。於是戰爭從邊境衝突變成圍城攻城，誰握有糧道與攻城器械，誰就決定城的歸屬。
causeEn: That Zhongdu should come to this pass was the product of three layers of cause. The outermost was the decay of the Jin dynasty itself: in the first year of Zhengyuan the Hailing emperor moved the capital from the old Yanjing to Zhongdu and raised triple walls on the model of Bianjing at an enormous cost to the treasury; the failure of the campaign against Song and the empty northern frontier that followed showed a gap between the frontier armies and their supply that was never closed. Under the Zhangzong and Weishao emperors government grew worse, the treasuries emptied, the court squeezed the wealth and the people, and hearts turned away; the resentment of the great families of the central plain and of the Khitans and Han Chinese against the rule of the Jurchen piled up, and the rising of the Red Jackets in Hedong in 1213 was the first bursting of that resentment. The middle layer was the Mongols: after unifying the steppe in 1206 Genghis Khan was in no hurry to march south, but first gathered up Western Xia, the Naimans, the Tibetans and, along with them, the craftsmen and the siegecraft of the Chinese districts, and only in 1211 broke the Jin's Hebei line in a single battle at Yehuling. The innermost layer was a choice made by the Jin court itself: the treaty bought by Pusan Anzhen in 1211 and 1212 with land, people and treasure was in effect an admission that Hebei could not be held, and the frontier was slack from that moment on; in 1213 the Mongols drove down in three columns straight to Zhongdu, and the Jin court wrestled between holding and abandoning, and the Xuanzong emperor in the end chose to move south, leaving an empty city and a city full of people to the Mongol horse. The war had thus changed from a frontier collision into a siege, and whoever held the grain road and the siege engines would decide the fate of the city.
impact: 中都陷落是金朝崩壞的關鍵一環。此後金只剩河南一地可以立足，河北、山西、山東盡失，中原的漕運與糧源隨之中斷，十九年後蔡州城破，東西兩漢地第一次完全歸於草原政權，蒙古也在這一輪之後把國號改為大元。另一面更長：蒙古軍在中都得到的並不只是一座城，而是一整套攻城技藝與一批懂得修城、屯田、徵糧的漢地吏員。城破之後蒙古人自己也守不住中都——中都太大、太空，沒有可耕的地可供騎兵就地生養，成吉思汗下令焚毀宮闕，軍隊帶著擄獲退回草原，燕京一帶廢為丘墟，這一廢就是五十餘年。直到 1264 年忽必烈把燕京定為陪都之號，1267 年命劉秉忠在金中都東北另築新城，1272 年以大都為都城，十一座城門與方整的宮城格局比金中都更大。此後明永樂年間正式改名北京，清朝沿用為京師，於是今日北京的都城格局，是從 1215 年那場大火之後的廢墟上重新長出來的：回到這座城市的人看到的是一條從中都到大都再到北京的連續血脈，而不是一條斷裂的根。技術上同樣有續：蒙古在中都攻城時所練成的圍城辦法，後來隨西征與南征一路擴散，投石機與火藥武器逐步進入蒙古軍的攻城序列，襄陽之役以回回砲攻城，即是這條技術線上的晚期形態。
impactEn: The fall of Zhongdu was a hinge in the disintegration of the Jin. After it the Jin had only Henan on which to stand; Hebei, Shanxi and Shandong were gone, and the canals and the grain of the central plain were cut off with them. Nineteen years later Caizhou fell, the two Han lands came wholly under the rule of the steppe for the first time, and the Mongols in that same round changed their name to the Great Yuan. The other side is longer. What the Mongol army took at Zhongdu was not merely a city but a whole body of siegecraft and a body of Chinese administrators who knew how to repair walls, open tilled land and levy grain. Having taken it, the Mongols could not hold it either: Zhongdu was too large and too empty, with no arable land to feed horses on the spot, so Genghis Khan ordered the palace burned, the army withdrew to the steppe with its captives, and the country about Yanjing lay in ruins for more than fifty years. Only in 1264 did Qubilai give Yanjing the title of a secondary capital, in 1267 did he order Liu Bingzhong to raise a new city to the north-east of the old Jin capital, and in 1272 was the new city made the capital as Dadu, with eleven gates and a rectilinear palace enclosure larger than anything the Jin had built. Later the Yongle emperor renamed the place Beijing proper and the Qing kept it as the capital, so that the plan of the capital today grew back out of the ruins left by the great fire of 1215: whoever returns to this city is looking at an unbroken line running from Zhongdu through Dadu to Beijing, not at a broken root. The technical line continues in the same way. The methods of siege drilled by the Mongols before Zhongdu spread outward with the western and southern campaigns, and the stone-thrower and the gunpowder weapon entered the Mongol order of assault step by step; the use of the huihui pao in the siege of Xiangyang is a late form of that same technical line.
result: 貞祐三年二月，蒙古軍入中都。守軍潰散，完顏承暉殉城，金朝在燕雲十六州的核心據點就此失去；宣宗所倚為根本的北方都城，連同城內的府庫、宮室、器械與大批居民，都成了蒙古軍的戰利。蒙古軍大掠而去，隨即放火焚毀宮闕，中都成為廢墟。金朝此後退守汴京，苟延至 1234 年蔡州之難而亡，河北與山東從此脫離中原王朝控制近半個世紀，直到 1279 年南宋亡後才重新統一。對這件兵器而言，此役是一次殘酷的證明：弩在中都城頭是守方最可靠的一種遠射武器，一發便能穿甲，卻守不住任何會動的東西——地道從牆下穿過，飛石落在城堞之間，糧道被切斷半日，城頭的射界再準確也不能挽救城牆。蒙古人後來在攻打南宋與吐蕃的城塞中，把投石機與火藥砲逐步推到前鋒，弩與弓在攻城中的地位隨之下降，轉回野戰與守寨的配角；這正是十字弩在整個十二世紀最誠實的一次定位：它是城牆上的好兵器，不是戰場上的好兵器。
resultEn: In the second month of Zhengyou 3 the Mongol army entered Zhongdu. The garrison broke and Wanyan Chenghui died with the city, and the Jin lost the central strongpoint of the Sixteen Prefectures; the northern capital on which the Xuanzong emperor had depended, with its treasuries, its palace buildings, its equipment and its crowds of inhabitants, became the booty of the Mongols. The army plundered, then set fire to the palace and withdrew, and Zhongdu became a ruin. The Jin fell back on Bianjing and survived until the disaster of Caizhou in 1234; Hebei and Shandong were from then on outside the control of the Chinese dynasties for close on half a century, and were only reunited after the fall of the Southern Song in 1279. For the weapon on this card the campaign was a brutal demonstration. On the walls of Zhongdu the crossbow was the most reliable ranged arm the defenders had, and a single bolt pierced armour, yet it could hold back nothing that moved: a mine passed beneath the wall, a thrown stone fell among the parapets, and half a day with the grain road cut was enough; no accuracy of shooting could save a rampart. In the years afterwards, as the Mongols attacked the cities of the Southern Song and Tibet, they pushed the stone-thrower and the gunpowder cannon to the front, and the crossbow and the bow fell back in the order of siege, returning to a supporting part in the field and behind stockades. That is the most honest single verdict the crossbow of the twelfth century ever received: it was a good weapon on a wall, and not a good weapon in the field.
